import math
import numpy as np

def r(x):
    return float(x) * 0.5

def R(y_orig, y_new):
    e_orig = abs(float(y_orig) - 1.0)
    e_new = abs(float(y_new) - 1.0)
    if e_orig < 1e-15:
        return e_new < 1e-15
    if e_new < 1e-15:
        return False
    order = math.log(e_orig / e_new) / math.log(2.0)
    return abs(order - 2.0) <= 0.2
